name: wardly-next-step
description: Wardly promo «Із хаосу — у наступний крок»: one beat-locked timeline drives picture and sound.

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && node scripts/lint-film.mjs src && tsx scripts/grid-check.ts src/timeline.ts
scripts.audio: python3 audio/build_soundtrack.py --cues out/cues.json --out public/audio/soundtrack.wav --stems out/stems --json out/qa/score.json
scripts.qa: mkdir -p out/qa && python3 scripts/probe.py out/film.mp4 --spec 1080x1920@60 --dur 25 && python3 scripts/check-sync.py out/film.mp4 public/audio/soundtrack.wav && python3 scripts/forensics.py out/film.mp4 --pace crisp --json out/qa/forensics.json
